title: Semantic diffing and migration plan for quant profiles
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: design and implement a migration-friendly, semantically-aware diffing and versioning mechanism for quantization profiles (FP8/INT8) so we can safely evolve calibration artifacts without breaking runtime serving or inflating storage. Scope includes: a canonical on-disk artifact layout, a compact semantic diff format for profile deltas, migration tooling to automatically reconcile model-serving expectations with newer profiles, and a small roll-forward/rollback CLI for operators. Excludes: changes to low-level kernel implementations or model IRs; those are handled by separate teams.
acceptance_criteria: Profiles stored in the artifact registry must have a semantic version and human-readable delta manifest
Given two profile versions, the CLI produces a deterministic migration plan (patch, apply, verify) with checksums and operation counts
Automated migration must succeed for 90% of internal test models in the nightly regression suite with <=1% accuracy deviation compared to baseline
Rollback completes within configured SLA (5 minutes for up to 10 concurrent nodes) and leaves a clear audit trail
Documentation and an operator playbook published to Confluence and linked from the Console rollout UI
migration_strategy: We will compute a semantic diff (field-level changes, op-level scale/zero-point shifts, calibration-statistics deltas) rather than byte diffs. Migration produces a sequence of idempotent steps: verify preconditions (model ID, shape, kernel compatibility), apply numeric transforms (rescale blocks, remap quant groups), recompute lightweight validation metrics on a small holdout, and sign the new profile. For major-incompatible changes the tool will emit a staged canary plan referencing dedicated test hosts in sandbox and require manual approval.
rollback_playbook: 1) Identify failing model-serving traces and profile version. 2) Run 'qr rollback --target <profile>' which validates checksums and initiates an orchestrated revert across nodes. 3) Verify health and accuracy on the canary route for 30 minutes. 4) If revert fails, escalate to on-call infra and open incident with linked logs and artifact provenance. 5) Append audit entry with rationale and operator id.
decisions: Use semantic versioning (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) for profiles to encode compatibility guarantees
Store both compact binary blobs and a lightweight JSON manifest to improve human debuggability
Prefer idempotent migration steps to simplify rollbacks and retries
Do not attempt lossy automatic rewrites for major model architecture changes — require manual migration path
notes: This ticket was created after a small outage where a calibration tweak caused higher-than-expected drift on a subset of production customers. We need faster diagnosis and safe rollbacks.
